result.summary:
Reviewed test/specs/ISS-0216.md in full: documents the criterion (check_prefix/2's pre-fix size/starts_with? logic trivially matches when prefix == ""), why two test cases exist rather than one (avoids the vacuity trap where a lazier fix could special-case only malformed-cursor+empty-prefix and leave well-formed-cursor+empty-prefix -- the real exploit shape -- open), and a full fail-then-pass log. This is genuine rationale, not a restatement of the fix diff.

Read both new tests in test/letflow/api/pagination_test.exs (lines 116-134, describe 'decode_cursor/4 and prefix validation (AC3)'): (1) a realistic cursor minted under 'T:' decoded with prefix '' asserts assert_raise ArgumentError, ~r/empty prefix/; (2) a payload with no colons ('anything') decoded with prefix '' asserts assert_raise ArgumentError with no message pattern, isolating that the raise is unconditional on prefix == '' alone. Both assert on decode_cursor/4's real public behavior, not internals. No @tag :skip anywhere in the file (grepped). No 'TODO: implement test' anywhere in the file or spec. No setup block shared across tests -- each test builds its own cursor/payload inline via System.system_time(:microsecond) (fresh per-test, not memoized/shared) and Pagination.encode_cursor/1; no test depends on another having run first or on any external fixture. Grepped the whole test file for password/secret/Keycloak/connection-string literals -- none found.

Independently reproduced the fail-then-pass proof myself, in my own fresh throwaway worktree (did not reuse or re-read TEST-DESIGNER's quoted output as evidence):

1. git worktree add --detach <scratch>/iss0216-prefix-check 32a8e39 (confirmed 32a8e39 is 2b0d881^ via git rev-parse 2b0d881^).
2. Confirmed via grep that the pre-fix lib/letflow/api/pagination.ex at that worktree has only the single original check_prefix/2 clause (byte_size/starts_with? logic), no leading prefix=="" guard -- verified myself, not taken on trust.
3. Copied the working checkout's deps/ and _build/ into the worktree (to avoid a network mix deps.get) and dropped in the current test/letflow/api/pagination_test.exs (with the two new ISS-0216 cases).
4. Ran MIX_ENV=test mix test test/letflow/api/pagination_test.exs --seed 0 in the worktree.

My own pre-fix run output:
```
Running ExUnit with seed: 0, max_cases: 16
Excluding tags: [:keycloak]

..................

  1) test decode_cursor/4 and prefix validation (AC3) ISS-0216: an empty prefix raises ArgumentError instead of silently matching (Letflow.Api.PaginationTest)
     test/letflow/api/pagination_test.exs:116
     Expected exception ArgumentError but nothing was raised
     code: assert_raise ArgumentError, ~r/empty prefix/, fn ->
     stacktrace:
       test/letflow/api/pagination_test.exs:120: (test)

  2) test decode_cursor/4 and prefix validation (AC3) ISS-0216: an empty prefix raises even against a payload with no colons at all (Letflow.Api.PaginationTest)
     test/letflow/api/pagination_test.exs:125
     Expected exception ArgumentError but nothing was raised
     code: assert_raise ArgumentError, fn ->
     stacktrace:
       test/letflow/api/pagination_test.exs:131: (test)

....................
Finished in 0.1 seconds (0.1s async, 0.00s sync)

Result: 38/40 passed
Failed: 2 tests
```

Both failures are behavioral ('Expected exception ArgumentError but nothing was raised'), not UndefinedFunctionError/name-resolution -- the code under test already existed pre-fix (check_prefix/2 was present, just missing the guard clause), so this is a real fail-then-pass proof and the additional mutant-isolation step required only when 'the code under test did not exist' does not apply here.
